City permit record lists RANCHO161 LLC as applicant and owner on H20-048 and ER20-264. Preliminary review PRE20-005 (filed 2020-01-09, applicant Muthanna Omran) shows zoning R-M.
SF YIMBY credits the project rendering to Rancho 161 LLC and describes exterior materials of white cement paneling, grey stone tiles and wood-like siding, with some on-site parking (no count given).
